*Kusalattika, Cūḷantaraduka* (Patthana 4.3) is an Abhidhamma text forming a component leaf of the *Paṭṭhāna* in the Pali Tipiṭaka. The text systematically investigates conditional relations by combining the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*) with the minor intermediate dyads (*cūḷantaraduka*).
